title: Sab ke bas ki baat nahi
body:
Sab ke bas ki baat nahi

sab ke bas ki baat nahi

seeno mein ye noor basana

2. Kaun bajuz Allah ali hai, aisa shaja o shareef o kareem..(2)

6. Ghair e rujul aur beghairat bhi, iske liye banna padhta hai..(2)

7. Qatl e marhab, fath e khaibar, aur phir darr ko bana lena pul..(2)

8. Marziye dawar aur jina ke, malik hi mangwa sakte hai..(2)

9. Takht e hukoomat, baaghe fidak aur, khums daba le jo chaahe..(2)

10. Aap pe hai ye sibt e jafar, khaas inayat meysam ki..(2)

11. Hirs o hawas, ghurbat be sabri, maula se na ummeedi..(2)
